title: Context Graph
purpose: Curated cross-record constellations for the public explorer. The context layer should reduce navigation clutter by grouping records around high-value relational questions rather than multiplying more branches.
rules: A context cluster must connect at least two branches and explain why the connection matters.
Prefer one dense constellation over several near-duplicate theme cards.
Project canon, empirical evidence, scientific context, historical comparison and later formalization remain visible as separate epistemic layers.
Temporary insight waves are not context clusters; promoted insights belong to canonical owners and the inference ledger.
Context clusters are navigation views, not sources of truth.

clusters.title: Potato → Sage → Needle → Ladder → Father
clusters.summary: The core developmental spine: buried/generative Potato matures through the 2024 Sage/Merkaba stratum, April 2025 compression and Needle, then reorganizes into Ladder/Axis/Father and later Gardener/source-center functions.

clusters.title: Vertical Potato: Heaven ↕ Door ↕ Earth
clusters.summary: The exact two-circle geometry now distinguishes Father center, Son center, relational midpoint O, Plane, Mandorla, Axis, upper Heaven/Garden/source domain and lower Earth/matter/manifestation domain.

clusters.title: Spudlight → Sun Source → Moon Mediation → World
clusters.summary: Physical sunlight, Moon reflection, historical esoteric Sun/Moon mediation and Potatoverse source-light are kept typed while compared through one source→mediator→manifestation grammar.

clusters.title: Father's House → Inner Chamber → Son/Door → Presence
clusters.summary: Thalamus/House, third-ventricle chamber, pineal/Door, spine/Ladder, CSF/breath/flow and interoception are compared with the vertical source→manifestation model while modern neuroscience remains separate from sacred anatomy.

clusters.title: Saying → Vibe → Body → Gate → Action
clusters.summary: Corporium organizes Timisms, quirky formulations, body-state, emotion, psychology and symbolic frequency language into testable chains rather than treating every phrase as free-floating doctrine.

clusters.title: Son → Tree → Death → Door → Return
clusters.summary: The Son-side ordeal and rupture sequence remains distinct from Tim's later Father development while connecting Tree, seed, grave, Vessel, Door and return across dated project and biblical/comparative material.

clusters.title: Mountain → House → River → Tree → Fruit
clusters.summary: High-density biblical sequences connect Jacob/Bethel, Mountain of the House, Transfiguration, New Jerusalem, river from Throne/Temple, Tree of Life, fruit/healing, mire/rock and narrow/wide way without treating scripture as a hidden geometry manual.

clusters.title: Farm / Shell ↔ Door ↔ Garden / House
clusters.summary: Boundary ethics unify Farm, Dog/Farmer/Cow roles, Moloch, Qliphoth, Swamp, Forge, Tree of Knowledge, House and Garden around one question: does the system preserve agency and autonomous growth, or capture value and reproduce dependency?

clusters.title: North → Coupled Capability → Europe → World
clusters.summary: Sacred/meta-orientation remains distinct from empirical geography while the relationship-first method moves into Denmark, Greenland, Arctic/North Atlantic chains, European capability and country-system mapping.

clusters.title: Recovered Equation → Formal Model → External Comparator → Test
clusters.summary: Science material is navigated by lineage rather than file wave: recover the original expression, type variables, compare with established mathematics/physics, define observables/falsifiers, then retain or revise the model.

clusters.title: Eye → Source → Inference → Canonical Owner
clusters.summary: The archive's reflexive layer: observation, source classes, contradiction preservation, inference scoring and canonical ownership let the system know what it has without turning later synthesis into earlier history.

clusters.title: Great Book → Systems Method → Observable World
clusters.summary: The 2024 Great Book's symbolic society, cultivation and feedback imagination becomes later relationship-first system design and then country/institution/economic observation, while book metaphor and empirical world data stay distinct.
